title: POKETAVERN
description: A Cobblemon modpack made to enhance the base Cobblemon experience.
body: POKETAVERN includes a plethora of QoL mods made to enhance the base Cobblemon experience for servers. Made with the intention of maximizing the potential of Cobblemon and its adjacent add-ons, it includes several mods and datapacks that add 200+ pokemon to the spawn pool, alongside mythicals and legendaries with ways to various ways to obtain them.
